gloss: another day, at a later date

definitions.gloss: another day, at a later date, some other time
definitions.explanation: A future point in time that is not specified. Used when postponing or deferring something, or when referring to events that occurred at some point after a reference point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後日|ごじつ}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will give a detailed explanation at a later date.

examples.japanese: {後日|ごじつ}、{改|あらた}めてご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will contact you again on another day.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{後日|ごじつ}になって⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: That fact came to light at a later time.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal expression used in both spoken and written Japanese. Common in business communication and polite speech. As an adverb, it modifies verbs directly ({後日|ごじつ}⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧). As a noun, it appears with particles ({後日|ごじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, {後日|ごじつ}になって).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {後日|ごじつ}{改|あらた}めて: on another occasion (polite set phrase)
- {後日|ごじつ}⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact at a later date
- {後日談|ごじつだん}: sequel, epilogue, follow-up story
